chunks: Other than his wife; it is decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.

key_terms.الْغَابِرِينَ: those who stay behind / those who remain

ai.seo_question: Who was the wife of Prophet Lut and why did she not enter Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between mere physical proximity to the Prophet and true spiritual adherence, as Lot's wife remained with her people despite being in his household. The phrase 'it is decreed' (qadarnā) underscores that her exclusion was a predetermined consequence of her internal disposition and choice, rather than an arbitrary divine decree. This narrative serves as a cautionary example of how one can be surrounded by prophetic guidance yet remain among the 'abiding' in disbelief due to personal conviction.
